object:pink / restore ability.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a bulb-bottom glass flask with a narrow neck, brown cork, dark rim, and pink liquid with a pale rose center and darker magenta rim. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:pink / restore ability.wikiDescription: The NetHack Wiki describes the potion of restore ability as a potion that restores lost attributes. The pink liquid is this atlas slot's appearance; most potion appearances can shuffle between games.
object:pink / restore ability.modelBrief: Use one shared narrow-neck clear bottle and brown cork, filling it with rose-pink liquid with a pale center. Keep the visible liquid appearance separate from its possible game effect.

sources.label: NetHack Wiki: Potion of restore ability
